summary: Bilibili filed a 6-K attaching its Hong Kong Stock Exchange announcement confirming completion, on November 5, 2026 (after HK trading hours), of a concurrent transaction with Tencent: Tencent's subsidiary subscribed for US$200 million principal amount of convertible notes, while Bilibili repurchased US$200 million of its Class Z Ordinary Shares and ADSs held by Tencent. The dual subscription-and-repurchase structure effectively reshapes Tencent's stake, with repurchased shares cancelled and a Rule 8A.15 conversion-price adjustment; shareholding tables show ownership before, after, and assuming full conversion. Watch Tencent's resulting stake, note overhang, and conversion dilution.
